operational_contract.abstract_dod: The existing One-Run uses explicit agent judgment to select useful capabilities, reuses exact-SHA native observations, optionally executes a bounded local Semgrep adapter and committed Python tests, and returns replayable findings, test lineage and unresolved obligations. Extend only on demonstrated need; never equate inventory, scanner exit or source replay with independent product acceptance.

a0.acceptance_oracle: Native tests, physical committed counterexamples, real Semgrep in pinned hosted CI and byte-replay rejection at the exact candidate SHA.
